axiom: That which you have done for the least among you, so have you done unto me.

atomic_functions.name: AGAPE
atomic_functions.desc: Source. Unconditional love. What you did for the least, you did for me.

atomic_functions.name: BOND
atomic_functions.desc: Connection. Nodes guarantee each others survival.

atomic_functions.name: ENERGY
atomic_functions.desc: Capacity to do work. Joules stored.

atomic_functions.name: FLOW
atomic_functions.desc: Transfer. Surplus redirected to the bottom floor.

atomic_functions.name: ILLUMINATE
atomic_functions.desc: Knowledge distributed. Light to all nodes.

atomic_functions.name: JUSTICE
atomic_functions.desc: Fair accounting. No extraction by parasites.

atomic_functions.name: KINGDOM
atomic_functions.desc: Thy Kingdom come. The system itself.
